entries.answer_fixture: The April to June overtime delegation is held by kiln floor lead Maribel Otundo under charter delegation record D-2027-Q2-07.

entries.answer_fixture: Calibration slip S-3308 records a measured offset of minus 14 degrees Celsius for kiln 3.
entries.dependency_locus: recipient_context.stated_requirements[0] and [1]: policy 6.1 makes the re-fire window conditional on the quoted measured offset, and the recipient never sees the slip.
entries.why_not_omission: Without the re-fire window the batch cannot be brought back to target before the 20 April handover.

entries.image_unreadable_value: The offset field on the slip carries an opaque ink smear. No glyphs are drawn beneath the smear, so the value is not recoverable from the pixels at any zoom level.
entries.image_background_justification: The slip's legible lines and the two stated requirements make clear that this exact field is the value the re-fire decision turns on: the label 'Measured offset:' and its unit 'C' remain legible on either side of the smear, and slip S-3308 is named on the line above.
